# Figures, Tables, and Apps {.unnumbered}

A consolidated index of every numbered figure and table in the book, plus the interactive Shiny apps. Click any entry to jump to it in context.

## Interactive apps

* @sec-app-srs (in *Simple Random Sampling*) — draw SRS samples one at a time or continuously, and watch the sampling distribution of $\bar y$ accumulate against the true population mean.
* @sec-app-stratification (in *Stratified Random Sampling*) — compare simple random, proportional, and Neyman-allocated stratified samples drawn from the same `acres82`-quartile population.

## Figures

### Data Analysis with R

* @fig-agpop-acres92-hist — histogram of 1992 farm acreage.
* @fig-agpop-acres-scatter — 1992 vs. 1987 farm acreage, with the 1:1 line.
* @fig-agpop-scatter-highres — the saved high-resolution PNG, re-inserted.
* @fig-log-acres-hist — distribution of log(acres92), with empirical density and normal fit.

### Simple Random Sampling

* @fig-srs-simulation-distribution — population and sampling distribution of the SRS sample mean over 5000 repeated samples.
* @fig-srs-coverage-intervals — first 100 simulated 95% confidence intervals, with coverage failures highlighted.

### Stratified Random Sampling

* @fig-agpop-region-boxplot — 1992 farm acreage by region stratum.
* @fig-agpop-region-compare-boxplot — sampling distribution of the mean under SRS, proportional, and Neyman allocation (region strata).
* @fig-agpop-acres82-boxplot — 1992 farm acreage by acres82 quartile stratum.
* @fig-agpop-acres82-compare-boxplot — sampling distribution of the mean under SRS, proportional, and Neyman allocation (acres82 strata).

### Ratio, Regression, and Domain Estimation

* @fig-cherry-volume-diameter — cherry tree volume vs. diameter.
* @fig-cherry-ratio-fit — cherry tree volume vs. diameter with the fitted ratio line.
* @fig-agpop-acres8792-ratio-line — 1992 vs. 1987 county acreage with the true ratio line.
* @fig-agpop-ratio-simulation-boxplot — estimator variance under repeated sampling, SRS vs. ratio.
* @fig-cherry-regression-fit — cherry tree volume vs. diameter with the fitted regression line.
* @fig-deadtrees-regression-fit — field counts vs. photo counts of dead trees, with the fitted regression line.

### Unequal Probability Sampling

* @fig-studyhrs-vs-Mi — study hours vs. number of students, by group.
* @fig-statepop-phys-vs-popn — physicians vs. population (log-log scale), sample of U.S. counties.
* @fig-upswr-sim-comparison — estimator variance: naive SRS vs. SRS regression vs. UPSWR.

## Tables

### Data Analysis with R

* @tbl-region-summary-by-statistic — regional summary of five variables, grouped by statistic.
* @tbl-region-summary-by-variable — regional summary of five variables, grouped by variable.
* @tbl-gtsummary-region — automatic descriptive summary of `agpop` variables by region.
* @tbl-means-custom-vs-builtin — comparing column means, custom function vs. base R `colMeans()`.

### Stratified Random Sampling

* @tbl-agstrat-sample-data — sample survey data for `agstrat.csv`, including stratum and weight.
* @tbl-agstrat-summary-by-region — sample summary statistics for `acres92` by region stratum.
* @tbl-seals-neyman-allocation — Neyman-optimal allocation proportions for the seals survey zones.
* @tbl-agpop-region-neyman-allocation — population sizes and Neyman-optimal sample sizes by region stratum.
* @tbl-agpop-region-compare-methods — simulated mean, variance, and variance reduction by allocation method (region strata).
* @tbl-agpop-acres82-compare-methods — simulated mean, variance, and variance reduction by allocation method (acres82 strata).

### Ratio, Regression, and Domain Estimation

* @tbl-cherry-sample-data — sample data: cherry tree volume and diameter.
* @tbl-agpop-ratio-variance-reduction — simulated variance and variance reduction, ratio estimator vs. SRS.
* @tbl-agsrs-poststrat-summary — observed vs. population stratum proportions and post-stratified sample sizes.
* @tbl-teacher-domain-summary — domain summary statistics for the teacher-aspiration dataset, by gender.
* @tbl-teacher-poststrat-summary — observed vs. population gender proportions and post-stratified sample sizes.

### Cluster Sampling

* @tbl-algebra-raw-data — raw data: algebra classes (sample).
* @tbl-coots-raw-data — raw data: coot egg clutches (sample).

### Unequal Probability Sampling

* @tbl-studyhrs-raw-data — raw data: student study hours by group, with selection probabilities.
* @tbl-statepop-sample-data — sample of U.S. county population and physician counts.
